name: Fund Cash In Breakdown 3
definition: Breakdown of cash movements into a fund as a result of investment funds transactions, eg, subscriptions or switch-in.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of cash flow in, expressed as an amount of money.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Amount of the cash flow in, expressed as a number of units.

NewAmountIndicator.name: New Amount Indicator
NewAmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash flow is an item that did not appear on the previously sent report, for example, because it was received close to cut-off time.

InvestmentFundTransactionInType.name: Investment Fund Transaction In Type
InvestmentFundTransactionInType.definition: Type of transaction that resulted in the cash-in movement, for example, subscription, switch-in.

OriginalOrderQuantityType.name: Original Order Quantity Type
OriginalOrderQuantityType.definition: Specifies how the original order was expressed that resulted in the cash-in movement, that is cash or units.

ChargeDetails.name: Charge Details
ChargeDetails.definition: Charge for the placement of an order.

CommissionDetails.name: Commission Details
CommissionDetails.definition: Information related to the commission applied to an order, for example, back-end or front-end commission.
